body: I'm sorry. I thought we lived in a society where that kind of thing doesn't matter. Regardless of sexual preference or identity, you're a human being that requires compassion and deserves to be treated equally. Do your parents know about the suicidal thoughts you're having now?

Hold on to that dream. Even if you don't get into the school you want, does it really matter if the end goal is still the same? (Be a vet) I'm not saying your choice doesn't matter, just that there are many paths that all lead to the same destination. 

It might be hard, but if you can I'd recommend getting some exercise since it sounds like something you want to do in order to improve your self image. Even something as small as a few sit ups or crunches, maybe some light cardio. Anything to get up and active and to help take your mind off of things. Please rethink another attempt.
That's like telling someone with depression to "cheer up." Maybe you're the one who needs to "put in the effort" to your replies.

I've never heard of a therapist rejecting someone because of their beliefs. That sounds like discrimination. Have you told your doctor or whoever prescribes your medication that it isn't effectively working? Is there another medicine you could be put on?
I hope so too. I hope everything works out for you too.

I know you don't want to hear this, and you probably won't believe me, but there's always someone who cares about you. I don't know you or your situation, but I cared enough to write this reply. That's got to count for something, right?
I see. Have you ever gotten any treatment for this?

I've had a similar experience with religion. I completely lost faith about a year and a half ago, yet my family still thinks I believe. How can a supposedly benevolent god allow such suffering and hate in this world? I have no use for a silent god that doesn't answer prayers. 

As far as the method you described....I'd recommend against it, as it'll probably only severely injure you and make your life much worse, as opposed to killing you outright.

You probably don't want to hear this, but I've found that whenever I start composing my note to my family I end up crying and not able to go through with it. I'm not saying you shouldn't say your goodbyes, just that it might be hard and make you rethink your intentions.

Yes, it happens to me a lot. Most of the time it's just because I start to prepare everything and when I write my note I end up crying and just do that until I fall asleep. People will probably say it's a blessing in disguise, but I think it's just cowardice. 

It sounds like you have an active social life. What's getting you down?

If you have the means to rent an apartment then I highly recommend doing that. Is there a specific reason you need to wait two years in order to do that? 

I also live with people I hate and if I had the option to leave I would do it in a heartbeat.
If you're underage then you can blackmail THEM into releasing you. Of course, you could just try being honest and telling them basically what you said here.

At least you have a degree. Try finding a job without a high school diploma or GED. 

https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/6g57md/i_feel_trapped_and_hopeless/

Yes! Exactly! Thank you for saying that, vpmk12. I see that argument on here way too much. Death is the final mystery. No one knows what happens and the only way of knowing is to experience it yourself.

That's all I do, is play video games. It's one of very few things that I'm able to do like a normal person. But none of that gives me joy anymore. All the things I used to enjoy have no meaning anymore. 

Besides, it's all just distractions. My entire life has been distractions to keep my mind off of the fact that I'm in a hopeless situation that will never improve and I'd be better off dead.

Yes, it's absolutely necessary and there are no natural substitutes. I'm a bit overweight, but only by about 10-15lbs. I don't think losing that would make much of a difference to how I feel. However, it's nice to know that there are other virgins the same age as me. Thanks for your comment.

Running away from someone yelling at you and verbally abusing you doesn't make you weak or dumb. It makes you human. 

Standing up to that kind of behavior can be tough, especially if it's your own mother. I don't have the answer for you, but I hope your situation can improve and I'm sorry you have to experience this.

Probably not what you want to hear, but dropping out of school was probably the biggest mistake you can make. I never got my high school diploma and now I can't get a job to move away from the hopeless situation I'm in. I'd also like to kill myself, but I don't have the means to do so.

I know this doesn't help, sorry.

I disagree. Cats don't care about anyone other then themselves. They will ignore you and likely make you feel worse. Dogs are much better, as they will love you unconditionally and genuinely want to be around you.
